arxiv-1806-05956.creator: Orna Kupferman, Gal Vardi
arxiv-1806-05956.description: Abstract . A flow network is a directed graph in which each edge has a capacity, bounding the amount of flow that can travel through it. Flow networks have attracted a lot of research in computer science. Indeed, many questions in numerous application areas can be reduced to questions about flow networks.

arxiv-2211-16036.title: PERISTOLE: PackagE that geneRates tIme delay plotS caused by graviTatiOnaL lEnsing numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 )
arxiv-2211-16036.creator: T.S.Sachin Venkatesh, Gaurav Pundir
arxiv-2211-16036.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by T.S.Sachin Venkatesh, Gaurav Pundir. We present PERISTOLE to study the various time delays associated with the pulsar rotation and other general relativistic aspects of binary pulsars. It is made available as an open-source python package which takes some parameters of the double pulsar system as input and outputs the rotational and latitudinal lensing delays along with the geometric and Shapiro delays that arise due to gravitational lensing.

arxiv-2308-00586.title: My encounters with Alex Müller and the perovskites
arxiv-2308-00586.creator: Amnon Aharony
arxiv-2308-00586.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Amnon Aharony. This paper is dedicated to the memory of Professor K. After describing our personal and scientific encounters since 1974, I concentrate on the many puzzles which appeared in our discussions and collaborations, involving the interplay between theory and experiments on the critical behavior of cubic perovskites which undergo (second or first) order transitions to a lower symmetry phases (trigonal or tetragonal).

arxiv-2507-07906.title: Agentic Retrieval of Topics and Insights from Earnings Calls Conference: FinIR: The 2nd Workshop on Financial Information Retrieval in the Era of Generative AI; July 17, 2025; Padua, Italy
arxiv-2507-07906.creator: Anant Gupta, Rajarshi Bhowmik, Geoffrey Gunow
arxiv-2507-07906.description: Abstract . Tracking the strategic focus of companies through topics in their earnings calls is a key task in financial analysis. However, as industries evolve, traditional topic modeling techniques struggle to dynamically capture emerging topics and their relationships. In this work, we propose an LLM-agent driven approach to discover and retrieve emerging topics from quarterly earnings calls.

arxiv-2510-03818.creator: Lulu Song 1 , Di Zhang 2 , Tingting Zhang 3
arxiv-2510-03818.description: Abstract Source polar coding is a potential solution for short blocklength-based low-latency key generation with limited sources, which is a critical aspect of six generation (6G) Internet of things. However, existing source coding schemes still suffer from significant degradation in key generation rate and reconciliation reliability in short blocklength regime.

pmc-12490443.creator: Goran Glavčić, Mario Zovak, Slavica Sović, Silvija Mašić, Nina Blažević, Zvonimir Misir, Zdenko Bilić, Marin Glavčić, Petra Radulović
pmc-12490443.description: SUMMARYRecent studies have shown an association of the number of tumor-associated macrophages (TAM) with the prognosis and treatment outcomes of ductal pancreatic adenocarcinoma. This study aimed to examine the correlation between CD86 and CD163 macrophage expression and clinical-pathological characteristics of the disease in patients operated on for pancreatic carcinoma.

pmc-12948795.title: Associations between chronotype, physical activity and cognition in a free-living setting
pmc-12948795.creator: Evie Holt, Benjamin Tari, Demi Ojo, Zaina Alavi, Evelyn Watson, Sarah Keating Bartlett, Flaminia Ronca
pmc-12948795.description: Chronotype is one’s inherent preferred pattern of sleep and activity within a 24 hour period. Late chronotypes in particular are prevalent among university students and have been associated with differences in physical activity and cognitive performance compared to earlier chronotypes.

pmc-12971786.title: Response on “Commentary on “Is gaitrite system sensitive in discriminating gait pattern of subjects affected by Charcot Marie tooth? A pilot study””
pmc-12971786.creator: Cristina Schenone, Marta Ponzano, Laura Mori
pmc-12971786.description: ork. As specified in the manuscript, our study was designed as a pilot, cross-sectional investigation, with the primary aim of exploring the feasibility and potential utility of an instrumented walkway system in patients with Charcot–Marie–Tooth disease (CMT). Our conclusions were intentionally cautious, avoiding any claim regarding disease severity stratification or longitudinal sensitivity to progression.

pmc-13006823.title: Plant cell surface receptors
pmc-13006823.creator: Bruno Pok Man Ngou, Yasuhiro Kadota, Ken Shirasu
pmc-13006823.description: SUMMARYPlants face constant environmental changes and must integrate external and internal cues to coordinate growth, development, reproduction, and stress responses. A major strategy is perception at the cell surface via a large, diverse network of receptors. Here, we outline how these receptors recognise extracellular signals and assemble active complexes with appropriate co‐receptors.

pmc-13067062.title: Selection for Function in Early Life: Implications for Early‐Onset Pathologies
pmc-13067062.creator: Klara Asselin, Antoine M Dujon, Jean‐Pascal Capp, Jean‐François Lemaître, Florence Pirard, Daniel Vaiman, Beata Ujvari, Pascal Pujol, James DeGregori, Aurora M Nedelcu, Frédéric Thomas
pmc-13067062.description: Persistent pathological structures, such as tumors, fibrotic nodules, granulomas, microbial biofilms, or protein aggregates, are traditionally viewed as age‐related conditions that emerge after reproduction, when natural selection is less effective at eliminating traits expressed late in life. However, some pathologies with robust and organized architectures can arise surprisingly early, challenging this classical perspective.

pmc-13277630.creator: Jordan Strack, William J Gavin, Angélica C Heredia-Flores, Cristina Nava Rios, Patricia L Davies, Emily C Merz
pmc-13277630.description: Socioeconomic disadvantage has been robustly linked with lower academic achievement in children. These associations may be partially attributable to the effects of socioeconomic disadvantage on error monitoring neural activity in children. The error positivity (Pe) is an event-related potential component that reflects higher-order neural processing involved in recognizing and evaluating errors.

pmc-13448915.title: In Situ Construction of Multifunctional Organosilicon/Organic Hybrid Resin Coatings on Wood Surfaces Based on the PMHS Si–H Click Reaction
pmc-13448915.creator: Zhixuan Ye, Xingshu Chen, Linxin Zhang, Jun Wang, Hanxian Chen, Xinxiang Zhang, Weiwei Zhao, Zhanhui Yuan
pmc-13448915.description: The abundant hydrophilic hydroxyl groups and porous structure make wood highly susceptible to moisture absorption from the environment, leading to issues such as deformation and decay. This work aims to in situ construct a multifunctional organosilicon/organic hybrid resin coating on the wood surface derived from the click reaction of polymethylhydrosiloxane (PMHS), using PMHS, divinylbenzene (DVB), and the Karstedt catalyst.

pmc-13493599.title: Annexin A2 facilitates Japanese encephalitis virus replication by regulating endocytosis and intracellular transport in PK15 cells
pmc-13493599.creator: Longqin Wei, Saixiao Li, Chunyu Wang, Hong Zhao, Wei Luo, Jinsong Li, Lanzhen Huang, Xishi Huang, Lantao Gu, Qingli Fang
pmc-13493599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionJapanese encephalitis virus (JEV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus that causes severe encephalitis in humans and reproductive disorders in pigs. However, the host factors that regulate JEV infection and replication remain incompletely understood.MethodIn this study, we used porcine kidney cells (PK15) infected with the attenuated JEV strain SA14-14-2 to identify host proteins interacting with the JEV envelope (E) protein by immunoprecipitation coupled with LC-MS/MS.ResultsAnnexin A2 (ANXA2) was identified as a candidate host factor associated with JEV infection.

pmc-13540721.title: Predator hunting modes induce varied selection pressures on prey personality
pmc-13540721.creator: Rebecca K McKee, Storm Miller, Carl N Keiser, Marin P Chester, Kristen M Hart, Robert A McCleery, Eva Ringler
pmc-13540721.description: Consistent individual differences in animal behavior—ie, personalities—have been documented in many taxa to have important fitness consequences in the context of predator-prey interactions. Multiple mechanisms have been suggested to maintain variation in prey personality traits, including life-history tradeoffs and divergent selection pressures from predators with different hunting strategies.

pmc-13585115.title: General and Pediatric Dentists' Knowledge and Clinical Management of Molar-incisor Hypomineralization in Dubai: A Cross-sectional Study
pmc-13585115.creator: AlAnood AlAnezi, Manal Al Halabi, Iyad Hussein, Anas Salami, Eman Alnuaimi, Mawlood Kowash
pmc-13585115.description: BackgroundMolar-incisor hypomineralization (MIH) poses notable diagnostic and therapeutic challenges for dental professionals. A comprehensive understanding of MIH among general dental practitioners (GDPs) and pediatric dentists (PDs) is critical to enhancing clinical outcomes in affected children.AimThis study aimed to evaluate and compare the knowledge, clinical management approaches, and self-reported confidence in treating MIH among GDPs and PDs practicing in Dubai.

uslaw-usc-t5-s5526.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t5-s5526.description: United States Code, Title 5 (Government Organization And Employees); Part III (Employees); Subpart D (Pay And Allowances); Chapter 55 (Pay Administration); Subchapter III (Advancement, Allotment, And Assignment Of Pay). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Funds available to an agency for payment of pay, allowances, and differentials to or for the accounts of employees of the agency are available on a reimbursable basis.
